query:
WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.tabpfn_projections` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2)
SELECT COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT gsis_id) n_gsis, COUNTIF(mean IS NULL OR q01 IS NULL OR q50 IS NULL OR q99 IS NULL) missing_core_values,
COUNTIF(q01>q05 OR q05>q10 OR q10>q20 OR q20>q30 OR q30>q40 OR q40>q50 OR q50>q60 OR q60>q70 OR q70>q80 OR q80>q90 OR q90>q95 OR q95>q99) nonmonotone_rows
FROM q
key_query: SELECT season,week,gsis_id FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_features.tabpfn_projections` WHERE season=2026 AND week=2 ORDER BY gsis_id
